mandateDomainVocabulary.note: WS-AGENT-MEMORY Slice 2 (D-AGENT-MEMORY-PERSISTENCE) — the closed, deduplicated mandate-domain vocabulary. Every persona's `mandateDomains` tag MUST appear here, and every AgentMemoryCommitted `domains[]` tag SHOULD draw from it. `shared` is RESERVED: it is the bank-wide common-core every agent loads in addition to its own mandate domains (readMyMemory unions {shared} into every agent's filter) — no persona lists it explicitly. Sourced (Charter cmd 4: source-don't-hardcode) by recon:agent-mandate-domains-coverage.

rules.engineeringVsGovernance: Engineering roles BUILD coded controls, projections, and platform components. Governance roles hold NAMED REGULATORY ACCOUNTABILITY and oversee the engineers' outputs. The two seat types are distinct; do not conflate them.
rules.mandateDomains: WS-AGENT-MEMORY Slice 2 (D-AGENT-MEMORY-PERSISTENCE) — every persona carries an EXPLICIT, non-empty `mandateDomains` (NOT derived from reportsTo or the domain-ownership map; governance seats own statutory domains with no engineering builder, so derivation breaks). It is the set of domain tags whose agent-memory that persona loads at dispatch. The reserved `shared` tag is the common-core every agent loads in addition; readMyMemory(agentId) returns memories whose domains intersect (the agent's mandateDomains ∪ {shared}). Enforced by recon:agent-mandate-domains-coverage + recon:agent-memory-recall-determinism.

rules.personaFiles: Each /Team/<name>.md is the operating spec for a standing autonomous agent (Principle 7). Canonical structure: 20 sections (1–5 legacy character data; 6–17 operating spec proper; 18–20 domain-competence — Authoritative knowledge base & sources, Domain-truth validation, Premise-challenge duty, per D-AGENT-DOMAIN-COMPETENCE 2026-06-25). Template at Team/_agent-spec-template.md. Files lacking sections 6–17 are findings until upgraded (Vera Wave-4 #10); §18–20 presence is enforced at warn severity (lifting to fail post-grooming) by recon:agent-spec-domain-competence.
